title: Chapter 98 Bloodline Promotion
content:
Chapter 98 Bloodline Promotion

Ao! ! !

Ao Qing, who had endured huge external forces, suddenly woke up.

Then he was furious.

"Which bastard dares to attack me?!"

At this moment, Ao Qing's dragon pupils had begun to change initially, gradually changing from ice blue to light brown, and a raging fire was burning inside.

However, when Ao Qing saw the "bastard" who took action in front of him, his expression suddenly became depressed.

With a puff, Ao Qing instantly stepped forward and wrapped around Lu Daosheng's thighs, and tears kept falling.

"Woooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooo

Looking at Ao Qing who was crying and acting skills soaring, Lu Dao's father and daughter both showed a hint of contempt on his face.

Then Lu Daosheng grabbed Ao Qing and said indifferently: "Ao Qing, you are really not afraid of suffocating yourself to death."

After eating so many high-quality goods, if Ao Qing hadn't had a deep foundation, he would have been too bad.

Hearing Lu Daosheng's words, Ao Qing was stunned and then said aggrievedly: "Master, this is really not my fault."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng sneered, "What, do you blame me for the food in Huangcheng for being so good that I can support you."

Seeing Lu Daosheng's appearance, Ao Qing was immediately frightened and trembled all over.

"Master, what I eat on weekdays is fed by the little master."

At this time, Ao Qing couldn't help but tell the truth.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng was stunned and turned his head to look at Lu Xue.

Seeing his father's gaze, Lu Xue quickly lowered her head, tugged her little finger, and whispered: "I, am I afraid of being hungry for him?"

Lu Daosheng:...

Finally, Lu Daosheng sighed slowly.

These two guys really have no choice.

"Master, I, I feel my stomach hurt."

At this time, Ao Qing spoke.

Hearing this, Lu Xue, who was beside him, immediately glared at Ao Qing, "I deserve it, I'll be able to hold you up to death."

I kindly found you so many delicious foods, but now I betrayed me.

When I eat, I see you are more delicious than anyone else.

However, Lu Daosheng stared at Ao Qing's belly, his expression slightly condensed.

That's it?

Lu Daosheng took out a pill and threw it into Ao Qing's mouth, then reached out and pressed it towards Ao Qing's stomach.

The next moment, Lu Daosheng exerted force suddenly.

Ao Qing immediately took a deep breath in pain.

At this time, Lu Xue, who was standing beside her, exclaimed: "Dad, look! There is something strange on Xiaoqing's belly!"

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng looked down and immediately found a piece of flesh and blood appearing on Ao Qing's abdomen, constantly squirming.

Seeing this scene, Lu Daosheng was silent.

There are rumors that there are five-clawed dragons, even six-clawed and seven-clawed dragons in this world.

It seems that this is true.

And this piece of flesh and blood that appeared out of thin air was Ao Qing's fifth claw.

At this time, Ao Qing had closed her eyes and her breath began to grow continuously.

Boom boom!

The powerful aura continued to pour out from the arrogant Qing's body, and the dragon's power shocked the entire city lord's mansion to notice it.

For a time, a large number of members of the Huangwei and the Gen began to come here constantly.

In the room, looking at Ao Qing at this time, Lu Xue looked surprised. Could this be the purpose of accumulating strength?

This guy either eats or sleeps on weekdays, but he is still so strong.

It's unreasonable.

I have worked so hard on my daily life, have I cultivated this stupid dragon?

Suddenly, Lu Xue stared at Ao Qing with envy and hatred.

Seeing Lu Xue's expression, Lu Daosheng was stunned and then said, "Xiaoxue, Ao Qing is a dragon clan, and his cultivation method is naturally different from yours. Although he is growing fast now, he has a lifespan. It's long."

Hearing this, Lu Xue's mouth twitched slightly.

Dad, will you comfort others?

Lu Daosheng also knew that he was saying the wrong thing, so he quickly changed his words and said, "Well, Ao Qing's cultivation is growing faster now because he has no blood bottleneck. The further he goes, the more difficult it will be for Ao Qing to improve. It is also the reason why the dragon clan rarely has truly top-level powerhouses. "

Because I want to cultivate a strong man from the Dragon Clan, the resources consumed are unimaginable.

To be precise, it just can't afford it.

Hearing this, Lu Xue finally sighed.

After talking for a long time, it means that Ao Qing has taken off.

With the financial conditions of one family, can’t you afford to support a one-stop?

I guess I can raise another hundred dragons, even my father can afford it.

However, when Lu Xue thought of herself as Ao Qing’s master, she had nothing to say. Although Ao Qing was unreliable on weekdays, Lu Xue was still very clear about her loyalty.

After a while, as the fifth claw on Ao Qing's abdomen was completely formed, a sacred aura suddenly surged out of Ao Qing's body.

At this moment, Ao Qing seemed to break through the blood barrier and completely stepped into the ranks of the dragon.

At the same time, in the distant world of all spirits.

The location of the dragon clan.

This place is no longer the dragon domain.

Because of the power of the deserted city, the dragon clan had to avoid the edge for a while and came to a remote place in the world of all spirits to survive.

On this day, a blood force suddenly boiled from all the people of the tribe.

All the dragons stopped what was in their hands and looked at their body in horror.

I saw a golden light constantly blooming in my body.

Feeling the boiling blood of the body's blood, the dragons looked horrified.

This, what's going on.

Boom!

Countless powerful dragons have awakened from their retreat, all with unprecedented solemnity.

Bloodline reversion?

Is this a dragon in their dragon clan that has broken through the blood barrier? !

Who is it?

At this time, a stronger breath surged from the depths of the dragon clan.

It was the ancestor of the dragon clan.

At this time, the ancestor of the dragon clan also looked solemn, but then he was ecstatic.

No matter who it is, as long as he is a member of his dragon clan, it will be fine. In this way, the powerful bloodline power will inevitably lead to the promotion of the entire dragon clan bloodline.

One person's success will bring success to the whole family!

Of course, all this depends on the willingness of the person whose bloodline has broken through.

At one point, Ao Lie looked up at the starry sky with a complicated look.

"Ah Qing, is that you?"

Xuanling Star Region, in the deserted city.

At this time, Ao Qing also felt the blood connection with the clan. At this moment, as long as he wanted, the bloodline of the entire dragon clan would rise collectively because of him.

But Ao Qing was silent.

He remembered the unpleasantness with the dragon clan when he returned to the clan.

More importantly, he had been driven out of the dragon clan by the ancestor of the dragon clan, and even his own father Ao Lie was separated from the position of clan leader because of him.

On the side, as if seeing Ao Qing's hesitation, Lu Daosheng said: "Ao Qing, it's the same thing, you can decide for yourself, no matter what decision you make, just be true to yourself."

Hearing this, Ao Qing immediately understood.

"Master, I know."

Then Ao Qing closed his eyes and his mind moved slightly.

Suddenly, countless giant dragons in the Wanling Realm began to heat up all over, their blood boiled, and their bodies radiated dazzling light.

This is a precursor to blood promotion.

Feeling this, countless dragon clan members excitedly looked up to the sky and roared.

God will not let me down!

And the ancestor of the dragon clan was also very excited. They, the dragon clan, still have the hope of dominating.
